content:
The audit report generation failed because the Word summary document did not include the required high-priority facility-session combinations.
While 5 tests passed, test_word_summary_content failed with 'AssertionError: Word summary must mention at least two high-priority facility-session combinations' (assert 0 >= 2). The verifier confirmed that OUTPUT_DOCX was created, but its text content lacked the expected facility-session identifiers (e.g., 'fac-sess') derived from the audit data. Avoid omitting specific session IDs in the summary narrative; ensure the logic correctly identifies and writes the top 4 sessions by total variance to the .docx file.
